desc: RCBS dies can be counted on to produce consistent and reliable results for shooters who demand reloads equal to the quality of their firearm. Includes plastic storage box and loading data table. Full-length sizer dies for bottleneck cases have vents to prevent case damage from trapped air and excessive lubricants. Seater dies have a built-in roll or taper crimper. Large, easy-to-adjust hex-lock rings.
